dialogues.jp: すっかり、音夢のヤツに置いてかれてしまった。
dialogues.en:
After all was said and done, that Nemu wasn't standing at
her usual place.
dialogues.text:
After all was said and done, that Nemu wasn't standing at
her usual place.

dialogues.jp: ちょっと遅くなっただけだというのに。
dialogues.en: I guess she didn't want to be late.
dialogues.text: I guess she didn't want to be late.

dialogues.jp:
あいつが玄関にいた時に、まだパジャマだった
だけなのに、あんなにそっぽを向くことはない
じゃないか。
dialogues.en: I couldn't exactly leave the hallway with just my pajamas...
dialogues.text: I couldn't exactly leave the hallway with just my pajamas...

dialogues.jp:
さて……あまりのんびりしていると、遅刻をし
てしまう。急ぐか。
dialogues.en:
Well now... if I don't start making a move now, I'd be late
myself.
dialogues.text:
Well now... if I don't start making a move now, I'd be late
myself.

dialogues.jp:
家の前の通りを歩いていると、後ろから車のク
ラクションが聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
I started to walk down the roadside, when I heard a loud car
horn behind me.
dialogues.text:
I started to walk down the roadside, when I heard a loud car
horn behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと、端っこ歩いてるだろうがよ！」
dialogues.en: "It's too early for that kind of noise!"
dialogues.text: "It's too early for that kind of noise!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、後ろからやってくる車を一｛にら／睨｝みくらいは
してやろうと待ちかまえていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned back to glare at the offender, who was travelling
surprisingly slowly.
dialogues.text:
I turned back to glare at the offender, who was travelling
surprisingly slowly.

dialogues.jp:
すると、クラクションの主であろう大きな黒い
車が俺の隣で停まった。
dialogues.en: It then stopped right next to where I was standing.
dialogues.text: It then stopped right next to where I was standing.

dialogues.jp: スモークのかかった窓がゆっくりと下りる。
dialogues.en:
The smoky glass window of the driver's seat slowly winded
down.
dialogues.text:
The smoky glass window of the driver's seat slowly winded
down.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning to you, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Good morning to you, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「せ、瀬場さん……」
dialogues.en: "S, Seiba-san..."
dialogues.text: "S, Seiba-san..."

dialogues.jp: ということは……。
dialogues.en: Which means...
dialogues.text: Which means...

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、月城。おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro. Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro. Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
車の後部座席には、月城がちょこんと座ってい
た。
dialogues.en:
Sitting upright and properly in the back seat, was
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Sitting upright and properly in the back seat, was
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いかがですか？　並木道の入り口までお送り
　いたしますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Would you like to come in? I would be able to drop you off
at the entrance to the Sakura Avenue."
dialogues.text:
"Would you like to come in? I would be able to drop you off
at the entrance to the Sakura Avenue."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「マジっすか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい。いつもお嬢様をお送りしておりますの
　で……」
dialogues.en:
"Most certainly. That is my route everyday with the
mistress."
dialogues.text:
"Most certainly. That is my route everyday with the
mistress."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、後ろの月城になにやら話すと、月
城がこくんと頷くのが見えた。
dialogues.en:
As Seiba-san spoke, Tsukishiro nodded her head in
confirmation.
dialogues.text:
As Seiba-san spoke, Tsukishiro nodded her head in
confirmation.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様が乗せて差し上げれば、と申されまし
　て……」
dialogues.en: "And it was the mistress's request to stop here for you..."
dialogues.text: "And it was the mistress's request to stop here for you..."

dialogues.jp: 月城が俺を……。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro wanted me to...
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro wanted me to...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、喜んでその車に乗ることにした。
dialogues.en: Overjoyed, I entered the car.
dialogues.text: Overjoyed, I entered the car.

dialogues.jp:
車は、高級車らしく、乗り心地がとてもよかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Being able to ride in a chauffeured limousine like this was
an amazing feeling.
dialogues.text:
Being able to ride in a chauffeured limousine like this was
an amazing feeling.

dialogues.jp:
おかげで俺は、随分と早く、並木道まで｛たど／辿｝りつ
くことができた。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to that, I reached the entrance to the Sakura Avenue
far faster than usual.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to that, I reached the entrance to the Sakura Avenue
far faster than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「さすがにここから先は、車が入れませんので」
dialogues.en:
"Unfortunately, vehicles are not permitted any further than
here."
dialogues.text:
"Unfortunately, vehicles are not permitted any further than
here."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「いやー、ありがとう瀬場さん。助かりました」
dialogues.en: "No no, thank you, Seiba-san. It was a big help."
dialogues.text: "No no, thank you, Seiba-san. It was a big help."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、ついでですので……」
dialogues.en: "Then, until next time."
dialogues.text: "Then, until next time."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんはにっこり笑うと、車に乗り、来た道
を戻っていった。
dialogues.en:
With a happy smile on his face, he boarded the car, and
headed back the way we came.
dialogues.text:
With a happy smile on his face, he boarded the car, and
headed back the way we came.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、毎日ここまで送ってもらってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, are you fetched here every day?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, are you fetched here every day?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いいなぁ、あんな乗り心地のいい車で送って
　もらえるなんて」
dialogues.en:
"That's awesome. Being able to ride in a car like that, and
getting dropped off here every day..."
dialogues.text:
"That's awesome. Being able to ride in a car like that, and
getting dropped off here every day..."

dialogues.jp:
ここまで来ると、あとはゆっくり歩いても、充
分間に合う。
dialogues.en:
Even just taking a slow walk, we'd make it to school with
plenty of time to spare.
dialogues.text:
Even just taking a slow walk, we'd make it to school with
plenty of time to spare.

dialogues.jp: 「さ、月城。一緒に学校へ行こう」
dialogues.en: "Alright, Tsukishiro! Let's head to school together."
dialogues.text: "Alright, Tsukishiro! Let's head to school together."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: The ever-present nod.
dialogues.text: The ever-present nod.

dialogues.jp: 俺と月城は、二人並んで並木道を歩き始めた。
dialogues.en: We started walking down the Sakura Avenue, side-by-side.
dialogues.text: We started walking down the Sakura Avenue, side-by-side.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あら、兄さん。どうしてこんなところに……」
dialogues.en: "Huh, nii-san? How did you get here so..."
dialogues.text: "Huh, nii-san? How did you get here so..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「よぉ、音夢。──俺は、日頃の行いがいいか
　ら今日はこうしてお姫様をエスコートさ」
dialogues.en:
"Yo, Nemu. --Unlike most days, today, I am the princess's
escort!"
dialogues.text:
"Yo, Nemu. --Unlike most days, today, I am the princess's
escort!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Princess?"
dialogues.text: "...Princess?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が、ぐいと俺の袖を引っ張る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro started tugging on my shirt.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro started tugging on my shirt.

dialogues.jp:
そして、恥ずかしそうな顔をして、俺をぐいぐ
いと引っ張るのだった。
dialogues.en:
I tunred to face her, and noticed her face had gotten red,
while the sleeve-tugging didn't stop.
dialogues.text:
I tunred to face her, and noticed her face had gotten red,
while the sleeve-tugging didn't stop.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、じゃあな！　音夢〜」
dialogues.en: "L, later, Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "L, later, Nemu!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城に引っ張られるまま、門を目指すの
だった。
dialogues.en: Following Tsukishiro's tugging, I headed into the school.
dialogues.text: Following Tsukishiro's tugging, I headed into the school.

dialogues.jp: ◆優雅な生活◆
dialogues.en: ◆Life of Elegance◆
dialogues.text: ◆Life of Elegance◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢に置いていかれ、ひとり家の前を歩いてい
ると瀬場さんの運転する車に声をかけられた。
dialogues.en:
As Nemu had gone off earlier, I left the house by myself,
and was spotted by the driving Seiba.
dialogues.text:
As Nemu had gone off earlier, I left the house by myself,
and was spotted by the driving Seiba.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、学校まで乗せていってくれるらしい。
しかも、月城本人の提案というのだから、なん
だか嬉しい。
dialogues.en:
It was to shorten the route to school, apparently. But,
hearing that it was a request from Tsukishiro herself, made
me happy.
dialogues.text:
It was to shorten the route to school, apparently. But,
hearing that it was a request from Tsukishiro herself, made
me happy.

dialogues.jp:
並木道の入り口まで送ってもらい、その後俺は
お姫様のエスコート気分で、月城と一緒に学校
へ向かったのだった。
dialogues.en:
Dropped off at the start of Sakura Avenue, and feeling like
a princess's escort, Tsukishiro and I headed to school
together.
dialogues.text:
Dropped off at the start of Sakura Avenue, and feeling like
a princess's escort, Tsukishiro and I headed to school
together.
